name: FA-INR
definition: Replaces Explorable INR's fixed spatial encoding with a learnable cross-attention mechanism over a memory bank and Mixture-of-Experts routing to concentrate capacity in spatially complex regions.
summary: FA-INR is a structure-aware volume exploration method that replaces fixed encoding with learnable cross-attention and Mixture-of-Experts to concentrate capacity in complex regions, offering higher accuracy and parameter efficiency than Explorable INR but lacking uncertainty estimates.
